channel.title: The Car Jury, News
channel.description: News and verdicts on the Indian car market from The Car Jury.

item.title: Porsche Cayenne Electric hits India on September 30: a Rs 1.76 crore hard sell
item.description: Porsche Cayenne Electric officially debuts in India on September 30, priced from Rs 1.76 crore, with up to 1,156hp and 642km range on offer.
